description: List suppliers that manufacture or trade goods under a given Harmonized System code, with optional structured filters. Use this when a buyer asks 'find me a supplier for HS code 8473.30' or 'who makes [HS-described product]'.

hsCode.description: Full or partial HS code (2-12 digits). E.g. "8473.30" or "847330".

lang.description: Locale for the returned URLs. Default en.
